name: Dina Suite Rome
summary: A suite hotel in Tiburtino, east of the historic center, with a terrace room on the listing.
description: Dina Suite Rome is at Via Domenico de Dominicis 36, in Tiburtino. Booking.com places it outside the postcard center, which is why a night here can sit under the hotels by the station. The rate printed here is the Double Room with Terrace the listing showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026.
facts: The checked room is the Double Room with Terrace
Booking.com showed the rate before VAT and city tax
